entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 28337 of 2024
Applicant :- Rajesh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravindra Sharma,V.P. Singh Kashyap
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ravindra Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ajit Madhesia, learned Aga
for the State-respondent.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
193 of 2024, under Sections 420, 507, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station- Ujhani, District- Budaun,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant was not named in the FIR and his name was disclosed in the present matter on the basis that he was one of the witness in the alleged fake sale deed, which was executed in favour of one Chandrapal, who was named in the FIR.

He further submitted that co-accused Amit Kumar was also witness of the sale deed and after considering entire facts of the case, he has been released on bail vide order dated 19.7.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 24835 of 2024 and case of applicant is at par with him.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

He further submitted that all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate-I Class and applicant is not having any criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 08.05.2024.
5. Per contra, learned AGA however, opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Considering the fact that only allegation against the applicant is that he was one of the witnesses of the sale deed alleged to have been executed in favour of co-accused Chandrapal and co-accused Amit Kumar with the similar allegation has been released on bail by this Court, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant- Rajesh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
10. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
11.

It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
